//: Typechecks shared/src AND the qa_*.ts harnesses. The harnesses were never typechecked by anything: client/tsconfig.json includes ../shared/src but not shared/ itself, and tsx strips types without checking them. That gap is exactly how a REQUIRED field (`promotions`) went missing from three separate typed AchSnapshot literals unnoticed — a missing field reads undefined, every comparison against it is false, and two achievements silently became unearnable while the suite still reported passing.
